preview_recheck.observed: The poster is now visible beneath the slide heading and visually matches the supplied asset. Governance on, the complete Touch ID prompt, the human-confirmation message, the click-to-play annotation, and the timing caption are legible and not clipped.

artifact.metadata_verification: MP4 track/sample timing parsed directly; Chrome independently reported matching duration and dimensions.

browser.name: Google Chrome
browser.delivery: Owned ephemeral loopback HTTP server serving only the video test page and the exact hashed MP4 bytes; byte-range response exercised.

continuous_playback.black_frame_method: Each delivered video-frame callback was drawn into a 160x90 canvas. A frame failed if mean luma was below 2 or fewer than 1% of pixels exceeded luma 8.

playback.boundary_playback_method: Seek to 0.2 seconds before each boundary, play at 1x past 0.2 seconds after it, and check currentTime and media error state.

visual_qa.method: Visual inspection of the three specified PNGs plus contact sheets generated from this Chrome decode and full-resolution opening, Touch ID, result, audit overview, and final proof frames.

opening.observed: The actual MP4 contains the Governance off title card at 0-2 seconds. Frames at 2.1, 3, 4, and 5 seconds show the browser and assistant request. The opening was checked from the MP4 rather than an older contact sheet.

limitations: PowerPoint is not installed. No PowerPoint or Keynote playback, embedded-media interaction, or slideshow rendering was tested or claimed.
Browser playback was tested in isolated headless Chrome at 1920x1080, not on the presentation projector or in a native slide show.
Frame-callback inspection covered 2263 delivered callbacks from a 2265-frame movie, supplemented by 40 exact-time decode samples; it was not an exhaustive manual inspection of every frame.

Source-time continuity and the final still's 78-second source position were checked against demo-video.json and the decoded final composition. Original recordings were not independently frame-compared in this pass.
This was media QA, not a new live authentication or application test.
